content:
Mira Solis: Quick kickoff for Riverstone EBR next Wed 10am PT. Need final slides + a separate technical appendix for the infra-deep-dive the customer requested. Asking owners: slides, appendix, demo fallback, and post-EBR pilot ask.

Ben Hart: I can take the technical appendix. Will include latency breakdown, cache hit rates, and a short note on quantized model tradeoffs. Will need runtime logs from last 30 days.

Isha Rao: I'll own the customer health slide and the renewal-risk scoring. Planning to use the new 1-10 numeric rubric and add an "adoption velocity" mini-chart. Link to draft: https://drive.redwood/riverstone/ebr-draft

Liam O'Connor: Demo lead here. Live demo is risky due to SAML SSO timing for Riverstone. I'll prepare a 2m recorded demo + 3 annotated screenshots as fallback. Uploading assets Thu 6pm.

Grace Wu: I'll draft the exec one-pager with 3 asks: (1) dedicated burst capacity for peak jobs, (2) prioritized infra fix for SSO jitter, (3) a 3-month targeted success pilot. I'll coordinate $$ with Finance.

qbr-bot: Event created: "Riverstone EBR - Dry Run" Wed 09:00 PT. Reminder 30m prior.

Mira Solis: Run order + core asks pasted below. Please ack your items and add blockers.

```
Run order:
1) Mira - TLDR & ask (4m)
2) Isha - Health & adoption velocity (7m)
3) Ben - Infra appendix highlights (6m)
4) Liam - Demo + fallback (6m)
5) Grace - Ask & pilot proposal (4m)
6) Q&A + action capture (13m)

Action items:
- Isha: finalize numeric risk + upload chart (Tue noon)
- Ben: compile runtime logs + appendix draft (Tue 5pm)
- Liam: upload demo mp4 + screenshots (Thu 6pm)
- Grace: one-pager draft + $ numbers (Wed noon)
- Mira: create feedback form and post-EBR pilot intake form (Wed EOD)
```

Ben Hart: Small note  the runtime logs include an anonymized request id mapping. Will scrub PII and upload to /files/riverstone-2002223334-logs.zip.

Isha Rao: For the renewal-risk slide, recommending we call out two top drivers: "low feature breadth" and "SSO reliability" with scores 7 and 6 respectively. Mira, do we want to propose mitigation owners?

Mira Solis: Yes, please assign owners. Suggest Product for feature breadth (Grace will sync) and Eng Infra for SSO (Ben & Liam to coordinate).

Liam O'Connor: Noted. Also adding a demo fallback flow to the appendix so execs understand how we'd degrade gracefully (screenshots -> video -> static flow).

Grace Wu: Finance asked for a conservative estimate for burst capacity: $12k/month incremental. I'll include a clear ROI line: expected latency delta and estimated retention lift for the pilot.

Ben Hart: One blocker: infra flagged a sporadic KV cache eviction event last week that could affect demo timing. @Mira can you loop infra-ops for an ETA on a fix? If unresolved we'll emphasize recorded demo.

Mira Solis: Looping infra-ops now. Also drafting the post-EBR pilot intake form. Intend to capture scope, success metrics, and contact owners. Will share a link Wed EOD.

qbr-bot: Runbook created: /runbooks/riverstone-2002223334.md

Isha Rao: Ill convert "at-risk" tags to numeric scores and add a short narrative per driver. Will upload the final slide Tue noon.

Liam O'Connor: Uploading demo assets Thu 18:00 PT. If anything changes I'll post here.

Mira Solis: Thanks team. Please mark tasks done in the runbook and leave quick notes if you hit blockers. Plan: internal dry run Wed 9am PT, leadership slice 10:30 PT if green. :rocket:
